description: Wait for mail in this session's private inbox (its address is in the result; type it into the app's email field). Returns the first message that matches, already there or arriving within timeout_ms: from, subject, text, the 4 to 8 digit codes and the links in it. Use it to finish an emailed code or magic-link sign-in. Fails with inbox_timeout when nothing matches in time. Only this session can read this inbox; mail is kept in memory and removed when the session ends.

from.description: Only mail whose sender contains this

subject.description: Only mail whose subject contains this (not case sensitive)

timeout_ms.description: How long to wait, in ms (default 10000)

name: inbox_wait
